column1: # GGUF PINS for the llama-server slot: logical id -> the exact file it serves.
# A tier row the llama-server slot cannot find here is REFUSED
# a file whose bytes differ is refused and deleted (gguf-digest-mismatch).
# PROVENANCE: trust on first fetch, at pin time. Each sha256 is the Hugging Face
# LFS oid (= the file's sha256) read from
# on the pinned_at date, and the downloaded bytes were hashed and matched. A pin
# proves the bytes served are the bytes the pinner saw; it is not a publisher
# signature. Whoever adds or bumps a row owns its digest and size.
# 482b pins T0 only. 482-igky ("482b-2") pins the rest, one row PER SHARD.
